title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to simply back up and transfer your workflows to another environment
summary: Business Central workflows can be backed up and transferred between environments using built-in import and export functionality. This approach avoids repeating time-consuming workflow setup and testing in multiple environments or projects.
key_points: Workflows are defined by events (with conditions) and responses (with options) that connect business-process tasks across users
Export workflows as XML files from the Workflows page using the Export to File action
Import the XML files into target environments using the Import from File action on the Workflows page
Importing a workflow with an existing code overwrites the previous workflow steps with the imported ones
Templates prefixed with MS- indicate workflows added by Microsoft

quotes.text: The standard functionality in Business Central supports the import and export of workflows.
quotes.why_it_matters: This confirms that workflow backup and transfer is a native capability, not requiring custom development.

quotes.text: If the workflow code already exists in the database, the workflow steps are overwritten with the steps in the imported workflow.
quotes.why_it_matters: Important caveat: existing workflows will be replaced during import, which affects planning for workflow migration.
